versions.description: First full build: dada.bounce physics source + 5 per-ball voice subpatchers (cycle~ + harmonic partial, adsr~, constant-power pan by x-position) + bach.roll accumulating display + master gain~/limi~/dac~ chain

UX pass: split the single Clear button into Reset (re-adds 5 balls + clears notation) and Clear-notation (keeps balls). Fixed bach.llll2list (doesn't exist in installed bach) -> bach.nth per-axis. Fixed expr clip() (not a valid function) -> min(max()). Targeted control labels so they stay near their boxes.
fix collision bach outputs: add @out t so bach.keys/bach.nth produce MAX-compatible atoms

Review fixes: pitch expr now fires on x (min/max Hz straight into cold inlets); speed list feeds sqrt expr directly (velocity was never computed -> adsr~ got 0 = note-off); adsr~ amplitude 0.05-1 (was 0-127), x127 only for score velocity; pipe->delay 400 note-off; trigger order pitch->env->note-off->score; bach.roll fed one addchord per collision (separate-syntax bang was wiping the roll, autoclear=1); cpuclock session start resets on roll-clear; Reset button fan-out via t b b; gain~ pair linked (L.1->R.0) with loadmess 110; removed dead y-position path.

Structure + UI pass: p dispatch parses each bounce once (bach.keys ball/position/speed -> pack -> route 1-5 -> voice inlets; voices take 'x speed'); shared receives min_hz/max_hz/session_start replace 15 per-voice sends; p init holds ball setup + session clock; loadmess defaults; room closed into a triangle ([3 1] edge) and balls 1/5 moved inside it; bach.roll scrolls via 'domain' (0-20 s, then 18 s back / 2 s ahead); patching layout reorganised (controls row, engine, score, voices/mix); presentation mode (bounce canvas | roll | Level fader, controls row) with openinpresentation + canvas bgcolor.

Voices: pitch + pan now reach the oscillators/pan gains through sig~ -> sah~ 0.001 triggered by the adsr~ output, so they change only when the envelope restarts from zero (adsr~ 5 ms retrigger ramp) -- no mid-release pitch/pan jumps; harmonic partial is *~ ratio at signal rate. Fixed session_start: the voice-side f was never banged, so onsets were raw cpuclock and Clear never restarted at 0 -- receive session_start now feeds the onset expr directly. Trigger objects on all remaining control fan-outs. Voice interiors re-laid out (input/pitch left, pan middle, envelope + score right).

Fix no-collisions: room setup message used the refpage's unkeyed graph syntax behind an 'llll' prefix and never applied (the saved state still held dada's default square); now 'bounce [room [vertices ...] [edges ...]]' matching dada's own dump format, and the triangle + 5 balls are also written into the saved bounce_data so they exist at load. Ball speeds were ~2 units (help/test patches use 100-200) -- balls crawled and took ~a minute to reach a wall; now 138-172 magnitude. Velocity scaling /8 -> /200 to match. bouncedata 1 saved as a box attribute.
Diagnostic + UI: 'last hit' readout in presentation (Ball, Hit x, Hz) fed by send last_hit (p dispatch) and send last_hz (voices), to diagnose 'only really low notes'.

Fix roll notes at pitch 0: the score trigger was 't l f f' with outlet 2 (an 'f') wired to the addchord message, so addchord got only the onset and $2-$4 defaulted to 0. Now 't f f l' (outlet 2 = list). ftom -> 'ftom 0.' so roll pitches keep their microtonal cents. Removed temporary print ROLL.
